competitors.what_they_have: Top Spanish result for 'cómo sacar el ABN'. Updated 13 Jan 2026. Seven numbered steps through the ABR form with screenshots, 'gratuito', TFN first, 11 digits, 28 days to report changes, how to cancel. No tax consequences, no employee vs contractor test, no GST, no FAQ block; some steps flagged by the author as from unofficial sources. This is the one to beat.

English, ranks for the Spanish queries too. Direct 'do I need an ABN on a working holiday visa' answer, TFN vs ABN section, links to ATO WHM pages. Weak: cites 2021 rates (32.5%, $18,200) under a 2026 title, no Spanish.

Spanish, dated 1 Jan 2026. Sections on income tax, GST, when to apply for an ABN, voluntary GST registration and a list of common mistakes (records, deadlines, over-claiming, not setting money aside). Links ATO, business.gov.au, ABR. Not working holiday specific, no figures, no FAQ.
Spanish sole trader tax basics, dated July 2026 (freshness signal). Generic, not visa specific.
Spanish ABN vs TFN format and validation reference (11 digits vs 9). Catches 'diferencia TFN y ABN'.

gap_summary: Every Spanish competitor answers 'cómo se saca' and 'qué es' in the first screen; we answer neither, and our ES hero lede even lacks the answer-first sentence the EN page has. Nobody in Spanish covers what we own (employee vs contractor, the ABR rule that an employer should not ask for an ABN, 47% no-ABN withholding, rideshare GST from the first fare, one return for both halves). Plan: add the how-to and a dated key-figures block on top of our angle, without dropping the angle.

facts.fact: Registering an ABN through the ABR is free; most applicants get the number when they finish the online application; an application under review can take about 20 business days
An ABN is an 11-digit number and does not replace your TFN; you have 28 days after becoming aware of a change to update details

'You're not entitled to an ABN for work that you carry out as an employee'; 'An employer shouldn't ask you to get an ABN as a condition of employment'; applying when not entitled may lead to prosecution or criminal charges
Ride-sourcing drivers must register for GST regardless of how much they earn, and need an ABN to do so
No-ABN withholding rate 47%; GST threshold $75,000; WHM rate 15% up to $45,000 from 1 July 2026, no tax-free threshold
TFN comes first because an ABN application is matched against it
facts.source: Our English page src/app/(site)/abn/page.tsx ('The TFN comes first, because an ABN application is matched against it')
